problem.numbering.companyNeedsEveryBranc: Every branch of the company numbers its documents with this sequence. Only someone who works in every branch of the company may change it.
problem.numbering.sequenceChanged: Someone changed this sequence after you opened it. Reload it to see their change, then make yours again.
problem.numbering.documentTypeUnknown: '{0}' is not a kind of document this workspace numbers.
problem.numbering.companyNotAllowed: You cannot number documents of that company.
problem.numbering.branchRequired: This company numbers each branch's documents on their own. Choose the branch of the document.
problem.numbering.branchNotOfCompany: That branch is not one of the company's branches.
problem.numbering.sequenceMissing: This company has no sequence for this kind of document yet. An administrator sets one up under Document numbering.
problem.numbering.busy: Another document of the same sequence is being saved and holds the next number. Try again in a moment.
problem.numbering.numberTaken: The sequence would give {0}, which an earlier document already has. Change the sequence's prefix, suffix or next number under Document numbering.
problem.numbering.readOnly: A number cannot be taken while only reading.
problem.numbering.dateOutOfRange: A document number can be given for dates from {0} to {1} only.
validation.numberingReset: Choose when the numbers start again: never, every year or every month.
validation.numberingYearlyNeedsYear: Numbers that start again every year need the year in the prefix or suffix ({YYYY} or {YY}), or this year's numbers would repeat last year's.
validation.numberingMonthlyNeedsMonth: Numbers that start again every month need the year and the month in the prefix or suffix ({YYYY} or {YY}, and {MM}).
validation.numberingPerBranchNeedsBranch: Numbers counted per branch need {BRANCH} in the prefix or suffix, or two branches would give the same number.
validation.numberingBranchNeedsPerBranch: {BRANCH} shows the branch's code: count the numbers per branch to use it.
validation.numberingToken: Use only the tokens {YYYY}, {YY}, {MM} and {BRANCH} between braces.
validation.numberingCharacters: Use letters A to Z, digits and the separators - / . _ # only.
validation.numberingNextNumberRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to {0}.
validation.numberingNextNumberPerBranch: Each branch keeps its own next number: it cannot be set for the whole company.
validation.numberingNextNumberBelowIssue: Number {0} has already been given. Enter a number above it.
validation.numberingGaplessNextNumberFix: Numbers of this period have been given and this sequence never skips: the next number stays {0}.
